Economy · India

Indian stock markets open lower amid rising crude oil prices

Indian stock markets opened lower on Monday, with the BSE Sensex declining by 284.85 points to 77,717.05 in early trade. The Nifty also opened lower. IT and tech stocks experienced a significant drop. This decline occurred amidst rising crude oil prices.
